nodes.label: SilverChat Working Agreements (CON-006 to CON-012)
nodes.rationale: Enforces step-by-step Step A hook extraction before JSX edits (CON-006), single commit per turn (CON-007), screenshot-free functional browser assertions (CON-008), branch publishing without PRs (CON-010), reduced-motion-safe 150-200ms micro-animations (CON-011), and explicit green/red evidence reporting (CON-012).

nodes.label: UI Migration Closeout Policy
nodes.rationale: Records Module 6A as the final chat-list migration and preserves _ui_reference donor paths strictly as historical provenance after directory deletion.
